eventModel: Components use native RmlUi events; applications own listeners and model updates.
modelBindingContract: The stylesheet primitives do not create model fields. Every expression referenced by consumer data-* markup must be declared before parsing; the bindings below state the expected type when that binding is used.
sizingContract: Lengths are RCSS CSS pixels before any client-specific scaling. A content-driven minimum means the component declares no min-width or min-height.
eventPayloadContract: Events are MQRmlUiEvent snapshots. Delegated controls should put data-mq-value on the logical action and read action_id/action_value; form controls expose their current string in value.

components.name: layout
components.keyboard: Not interactive; focus order remains the DOM order of interactive descendants.

components.name: stat-card
components.keyboard: Not interactive; provide readable text when the icon conveys information.

components.name: button
components.keyboard: Native button Tab focus and Enter/Space activation. Disabled buttons are not actionable. Add data-mq-value when the listener needs a stable action value.

components.name: icon-button
components.keyboard: Native button Tab focus and Enter/Space activation. Supply an accessible readable name adjacent to the icon; a glyph alone is not a label.

components.name: segmented-control

modelBindings.when: Used to reflect the selected segment.

components.keyboard: Each segment must be a native button and follows DOM Tab order with Enter/Space activation. Arrow-key navigation is not provided; the application updates the selected class/model after click.

components.name: switch

modelBindings.when: Used to reflect the checked state.

components.keyboard: Native button Tab focus and Enter/Space activation. Application owns checked state and must provide a readable associated label.

components.name: badge
components.keyboard: Not interactive; communicate status with text or another non-color cue when color alone would be ambiguous.

components.name: text-input
components.keyboard: Native RmlUi text editing and Tab behavior. Associate a visible label and preserve normal text-editing keys.

components.name: progress
components.keyboard: Not interactive. Expose the numeric value in readable text when the value matters.

components.name: toolbar
components.keyboard: Not interactive itself; focus order follows interactive descendants in DOM order.

components.name: table

modelBindings.when: Used to render rows; record shape is application-defined.

components.keyboard: Rows are presentational and not keyboard-activated by default. Put an explicit native button or other keyboard-operable control in a row when selection or actions are available.

components.name: notice
components.keyboard: Not interactive; include text and do not rely on color alone to communicate severity.

components.name: tooltip
components.keyboard: CSS hover visibility only. No focus trigger, delay, dismissal, or accessible-description behavior is guaranteed.

components.name: empty-state
components.keyboard: Not interactive; interactive recovery actions should use a separately labeled native button.
